theorem lg_target (c : ℝ) : (fun x => Real.log (x * c)) =O[Filter.atTop] Real.log := by
  -- Use logarithmic identity: log(x * c) = log x + log c
  have h1 : (fun x => Real.log (x * c)) = (fun x => Real.log x + Real.log c) :=
    Funext (λ x, Real.log_mul x c)
  -- Show that Real.log x + Real.log c is in O(Real.log)
  have h2 : (fun x => Real.log x + Real.log c) =O[Filter.atTop] Real.log :=
    let f := fun x => Real.log x + Real.log c
    let g := Real.log
    let h := fun x => Real.log x
    let k := fun x => Real.log c
    have h3 : h =O[Filter.atTop] g :=
      Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop
    have h4 : k =o[Filter.atTop] g :=
      Real.isLittleO_const_log_atTop c
    have h5 : f =O[Filter.atTop] g :=
      isLittleO_add h3 h4
  -- Conclude using the equality from h1 and h2
  rw [h1, h2]
